name: redis-oci-meta
description: Redis from the official Docker image; every acknowledged SET must survive.

services.name: redis
services.ready: hydo-oci redis redis-cli ping | grep -q PONG

workload.run:
i=$HYDO_FROM
while [ $i -lt $HYDO_TO ]; do
  r=$(timeout 2 hydo-oci redis redis-cli SET k:$i v$i 2>/dev/null)   # a 2 s client deadline
  if [ "$r" = OK ]; then echo $i >> $HYDO_ACKED; echo "$i ack" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES
  else echo "$i unknown" >> $HYDO_OUTCOMES; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
done

knobs.name: Redis appendfsync
knobs.set: hydo-oci redis redis-cli CONFIG SET appendfsync $HYDO_VALUE

invariants.msg: owners, modes and setuid/setgid bits from the image are in effect inside the guest
invariants.cmd:
bad=0
say() { echo "OCIMETA $*" > /dev/console; }
exp() {  # <path> <octal perm> <uid> <gid>
  got=$(hydo-oci redis stat -c '%a %u %g' "$1")
  say "$1 $got"
  [ "$got" = "$2 $3 $4" ] || { say "MISMATCH $1 want '$2 $3 $4'"; bad=1; }
}
exp /usr/bin/su 4755 0 0
exp /usr/bin/passwd 4755 0 0
exp /usr/bin/mount 4755 0 0
exp /usr/bin/chage 2755 0 42
exp /usr/sbin/unix_chkpwd 2755 0 42
exp /etc/shadow 640 0 42
exp /tmp 1777 0 0
exp /var/mail 2775 0 8
exp /var/cache/apt/archives/partial 700 42 0
say "/data (the data disk mount) $(hydo-oci redis stat -c '%a %u %g' /data)"
exp /usr/local/bin/redis-server 755 0 0
exp /usr/local/bin/gosu 755 0 0
say "id-redis $(hydo-oci redis id redis)"
for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do
  c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null)
  case "$c" in redis-server*) u=$(grep '^Uid:' $p/status); g=$(grep '^Gid:' $p/status)
    say "proc ${p#/proc/} '$c' $u $g"
    set -- $u; [ "$2" = 999 ] && [ "$3" = 999 ] || { say "MISMATCH redis-server not running as uid 999"; bad=1; };;
  esac
done
say "datafiles $(hydo-oci redis sh -c 'ls -lnR /data | tr "\n" "|"')"
n=$(hydo-oci redis find /data ! -user 999 | wc -l); say "data-not-redis $n"; [ "$n" = 0 ] || bad=1
# functional: as the redis user, /etc/shadow is unreadable, but setgid-shadow chage can read it
if hydo-oci redis gosu redis cat /etc/shadow >/dev/null 2>&1; then say "MISMATCH redis can read shadow"; bad=1; else say "redis cat shadow: denied (ok)"; fi
if r=$(hydo-oci redis gosu redis chage -l redis 2>&1); then say "redis chage -l via setgid: ok ($(echo "$r" | head -1))"; else say "MISMATCH setgid chage failed: $r"; bad=1; fi
say "redis euid via setuid su? $(hydo-oci redis gosu redis sh -c 'ls -ln /usr/bin/su; id')"
[ $bad = 0 ] && echo "image metadata in effect" 
[ $bad = 0 ]

invariants.msg: every SET the client saw acknowledged reads back with its value
invariants.cmd:
lost=0
for i in $(cat $HYDO_ACKED); do
  [ "$(hydo-oci redis redis-cli GET k:$i)" = "v$i" ] || { echo "key k:$i lost"; lost=1; break; }
done
[ $lost = 0 ] && echo "acked=$(wc -l < $HYDO_ACKED) all present"
[ $lost = 0 ]
